title: Promote {{name}} · version {{version}}
description: It moves out of {{socio}}’s computer into the workspace app runtime, at the same address, and keeps its data in your data space.
description-loading: It moves out of the socio’s computer into the workspace app runtime, at the same address, and keeps its data in your data space.

review.no-runtime: The workspace app runtime is not set up on this server (APPS_RUNTIME_URL), so it can’t be promoted yet.
review.no-secrets: No secrets here: the values are stored with the app.

data.none: This version uses no datasets: nothing to decide here.
data.shared-note: Everyone who uses {{socio}} sees this data. Moving or sharing it takes these tables out of the shared dataset into a new workspace dataset, which belongs to the workspace, not to you, and stays with it. {{socio}} asks to keep writing to it, and can once you approve that request. Keeping it leaves the app on the shared dataset.
data.gone: This dataset is gone; ask the socio to package a version without it.
data.socio-asks: {{socio}} asks to keep writing to it (you approve)

move.title: Move it to your workspace
move.line: Into a new dataset of yours, out of the socio’s scratch space.

share.title: Share it with a Space
share.line: Its members can read it; the app writes it. Scratch data is moved first.

keep.title: Keep it where it is
keep.line: The app uses it there; nothing moves.

move.title: Move it to a workspace dataset
move.line: Into a new dataset of the workspace’s, not yours, out of the socio’s shared dataset.

share.title: Move it and share it with a Space
share.line: Into a new workspace dataset its members can read; the app writes it.

keep.title: Keep it where it is
keep.line: The app uses the socio’s shared dataset; nothing moves.

describe.move_reads: Move into “{{name}}” (the socio keeps read access)
describe.move-shared_asks: Move into the workspace dataset “{{name}}” ({{socio}} can write to it once you approve)
describe.share-shared: Move into the workspace dataset “{{name}}”, shared with {{space}}
describe.share-shared_asks: Move into the workspace dataset “{{name}}”, shared with {{space}} ({{socio}} can write to it once you approve)

confirm.intro: Version {{version}} runs in the workspace app runtime at its current address; only you can open it until you share it.
